content: Service Name Sec OC_ Main Function Rx Syntax void Sec OC_ Main Function Rx ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x06 Specification of Secure Onboard Communication AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 86 of 161 Document ID 654 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SecureOnboardCommunication - AUTOSAR confidential - Description This function performs the processing of the Sec OC module's authentication and verification processing for the Rx path. Available via Sch M_ Sec OC.h

Service Name Sec OC_ Main Function Rx Syntax void Sec OC_ Main Function Rx ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x06 Description This function performs the processing of the Sec OC module's authentication and verification processing for the Rx path. Per configured Sec OCMain Function Rx instance one Sec OC_ Main Function Rx_<short Name> shall be implemented. Hereby <shor t Name> is the short name of the Sec OCMain Function Rx configuration container in the ECU configuration. Available via Sch M_ Sec OC.h
